media.alt_text: A photo of the Transgender pride, Rainbow, Progress pride, Intersex pride and Bisexual pride flags flying on the Parliamentary Forecourt on a rainy Wellington day.

post.text: NZ Parliament @NZParliament May 16, 2022 Happy #idahobit - International Day Against Homophobia, Transphobia and Biphobia. If you brave the Wellington weather today, you'll see the Transgender pride, Rainbow, Progress pride, Intersex pride and Bisexual pride flags flying #OnTheForecourt!
